translations.web: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
translations.bsb: He looked up at the window and called out, “Who is on my side? Who?” And two or three eunuchs looked down at him.
translations.kjv: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
